assets.prompt: Seamless tileable PBR base color texture for an old Brazilian university interior floor: beige ivory granilite/terrazzo, finely distributed irregular tiny grey, tan and off-white stone aggregate in an aged warm grey cement binder. A single continuous surface, no tile grid, no grout lines, no cracks, no perspective, no objects, no shadows, no directional illumination, no specular highlights. Subtle natural mottling and restrained foot traffic wear, moderate low contrast, evenly lit top-down orthographic material scan. Photorealistic survival horror material but still identifiable as institutional indoor terrazzo, not outdoor paving. Square 1024x1024 texture fills entire canvas edge to edge, perfect seamless repeat.

Create a production game texture atlas, image dimensions 1536x2304, composed of exactly SIX equal horizontal chalkboard strips stacked vertically, no gaps and no borders. Each strip is 1536x384, a 4:1 wide classroom blackboard surface. Every strip has the same realistic very dark forest-green worn slate with erased chalk smears, fine scratches and rubbed corners; no frames, no perspective, no objects. Clearly legible WHITE CHALK HANDWRITING drawn by a human teacher or frightened student, varied sizes and uneven pressure, chalk dust broken strokes, never typeset typography. Exact writing per strip from TOP to BOTTOM: 1: 'DIREITO CIVIL' with smaller 'PESSOAS • PATRIMÔNIO • CONTRATOS'; 2: 'CONSTITUIÇÃO' with smaller 'DIREITOS E GARANTIAS'; 3: 'SOCORRO' with smaller 'AINDA TEM GENTE AQUI'; 4: 'NÃO ABRAM A PORTA'; 5: 'A ÚLTIMA AULA NÃO TERMINOU'; 6: 'ELES VOLTAM QUANDO A LUZ APAGA'. Keep writing safely within the middle 80% of each strip, one or two lines maximum per strip, no extra text or symbols, consistent diffuse surface illumination. Authentic Brazilian abandoned university survival horror, realistic chalk on board, not clean digital lettering. This is a flat six-row texture sheet for applying each row to a separate wide board.
